versions.content: Variable Interpolation The content of a tag that contains the at- tribute blueprintValue will be modified during blueprint derivation. The value of this attribute after an variable interpolation will become the new value of the tag. The orig- inal content of the tag is discarded. Variable interpolation means, that the parts that are enclosed in curly braces are interpreted as names of values and will be replaced by the corresponding values. All other parts are copied as is. The run-time type of a value bound to a name used for variable interpolation shall be String or Integer .
